summary: Executed backend pytest regression and multi-pass UI/integration testing on public preview URL. Core dashboard flows work, but key issues remain in API health routes and grid UX behaviors.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 502 (Cloudflare bad gateway) from preview host.
Returns HTTP 502 (Cloudflare bad gateway) from preview host.

ui_bugs.issue: Amount column sort interaction does not change row ordering after repeated header clicks.
When search yields zero rows, visible count updates to 0 but configured empty-state message is not displayed.

integration_issues.issue: Kernel and Zapier health endpoints are unavailable through preview ingress (502), so system status cannot represent live backend checks for these integrations.

action_items: Fix preview routing/service wiring for /api/kernel/health and /api/zapier/health (currently 502).
Fix AG Grid sorting behavior for Amount column in overview table.
Render visible empty-state message when quick filter returns zero transactions.
Review AG Grid API warnings (paginationPageSizeSelector runtime mutation/deprecated APIs) to avoid instability during responsive operations.
critical_code_review_comments: orchestrator_agent/agent.py uses hardcoded defaults for service URLs and threshold; prefer env-only fail-fast behavior for production parity.
workspace.js calls gridApi.setGridOption('paginationPageSizeSelector', ...) after init; AG Grid warns this property is initial-only and runtime updates are ignored.
Intermittent page errors were observed in one automation run logs; investigate AG Grid runtime API usage under heavy interaction.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created; only runtime simulation calls were executed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Most UI routes/features pass (responsive widths incl. 320/768/1024/1440/1920, mobile sidebar collapse, KPI defaults, risk filters, search on hidden fields, drawer focus trap/close methods, disabled refund/freeze notice, copy actions, custom simulation adds exactly one row, CSV filtered export works with no internal id). Re-verify empty state rendering and sort after fix. Re-run API checks for kernel/zapier health after ingress/backend fix.
rca of the issue: RCA 1: /api/kernel/health and /api/zapier/health fail at host/ingress layer (Cloudflare 502), not application-level 4xx validation; likely upstream service unavailability/misroute behind preview gateway. RCA 2: Empty state likely not mounted/shown by current AG Grid overlay behavior despite overlayNoRowsTemplate config. RCA 3: Sorting appears non-functional in UI interaction; likely header sort event not binding correctly or grid state locked by current options/theme setup.
